description: Gravimetric liquid-class verification for automated liquid handlers. Limits are project defaults by target volume; set them per method.
limits_source: project_defined -- vendor accuracy specs are a best case and ISO 8655-2 limits are written for hand pipettes; agree method limits with the client before verification
densities_note: Nominal values at ~20-25 C. Measure the client's actual reagent (weigh a known volume with a calibrated pipette) and override per file with a '# density_<liquid>: <g/mL>' header.
